<thought>We need the number of aromatic carbons in the molecule, but we have no structural information. The only way to infer it is to obtain the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample, which will list chemical shifts for each carbon. Aromatic carbons typically appear in the 110‑160 ppm region. By counting the peaks in that region we can determine the number of aromatic carbons. We'll request the 13C NMR spectrum for the current sample.</thought>
